gen-gf-gupter-fs-bespoke-sans: Editorial through and through, Gupter packs its stems close together. Bespoke Sans follows with lower stroke contrast and generous space where its curves meet the stem, easing the heading's tight rhythm.
gen-gf-hubot-sans-fs-literata: Hubot Sans is approachable, with open apertures all the way through. Literata, a text serif whose curves keep wide, unclosed mouths, makes extended reading feel bookish and sturdy beneath it.
gen-gf-ibarra-real-nova-fs-bespoke-sans: Ibarra Real Nova stacks heavy columns against thin joins, like thread pulled between fence posts. And Bespoke Sans, low in contrast and sharp, makes the sturdy-versus-fine gap the whole appeal.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-mono-fs-literata: Technical and precise, IBM Plex Mono lays out fixed-width, code-style letters with extended spacing. But Literata, bookish with finer thin strokes, softens the grid with curves that open wide.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic-fs-literata: Open-eyed e shapes define IBM Plex Sans Arabic. Literata, a serif with moderate thick-thin shifts and wide, unclosed curves, adds the bookish weight that the low-contrast heading plainly lacks.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-condensed-fs-litera: Crisp and compact, IBM Plex Sans Condensed leaves its e open with a clear gap. And Literata, bookish and sturdy with modest thick-thin shifts, gives that snug grip a softer partner.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanagari-fs-liter: Spacious gaps at the curve ends set IBM Plex Sans Devanagari apart. Literata follows, a text serif whose gentle tapering at the bends should carry page after page in a warm, bookish tone.
gen-gf-im-fell-dw-pica-sc-fs-bespoke-san: Soft shifts in thickness mark IM Fell DW Pica SC, never turning stark. Bespoke Sans then reads with low contrast and sharp, spacious curves, so longer text moves along cleanly.
gen-gf-im-fell-french-canon-fs-bespoke-s: Bookish and refined, IM Fell French Canon flares its terminals outward. Bespoke Sans, plain and low in contrast, lets the heading's fat verticals and hairline diagonals be the whole drama.
gen-gf-inknut-antiqua-fs-bespoke-sans: Inknut Antiqua spaces its letters widely, with a mild taper like rolled wire. Bespoke Sans, a sharp sans-serif with low contrast, makes the stencil-cut heading feel more dignified by comparison.
